decisions.statement: The ask is written and the signal sent in one motion.
A supervisor is signalled only where the start time read now matches the start time held.
A seat with no readable process is reported rather than signalled.
A seat whose supervisor is gone is reported rather than signalled.
A signal that could not be sent is reported against the seat the signal was meant for.
Every seat is acted on rather than the run stopping at the first that refuses.
A fleet answered as holding no seat is the pages being wrong.
The seats reached are the seats the index files, whatever folder they sit in.
Each seat is named as soon as that seat has been asked and signalled.
A restart that threw part way names those seats in its refusal.
The restarting this runs is handed in.

definition: the command restarting every seat's supervisor onto the code standing now
